samples.question: This image has two framed panels. The upper panel, labeled REF, shows a chain: six round gray joints joined end to end by five straight gray rods. Exactly one interior joint of REF is circled in black. The lower panel, labeled COPY, shows the same chain after it was picked up, resized, turned around, and re-bent at its joints. Re-bending changed every bend angle, and resizing multiplied every rod length by one and the same unknown factor, so only the ordered sequence of rod lengths survives, and the chain may be read starting from either of its two ends. Rod lengths, joint positions and bend angles in COPY are otherwise unrelated to REF. In COPY the six joints are painted red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple in some order, and the paint carries no information about which joint is which. Exactly one joint of COPY is the same joint of the chain as the circled joint of REF. Which color is that joint painted in COPY? Answer with exactly one of: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.
